summary.text: Leader of the Danaans whom Hector slew in his rampage when Zeus vouchsafed him glory — distinct from other Homeric bearers of the name in later books.

story.text: Who then was first to be slain, and who last by Hector, Priam's son, when Zeus vouchsafed him glory? Among the nine leaders of the Danaans he smote Orus together with Aesymnus and Hipponous, staunch in fight, and thereafter fell upon the multitude.
